fact: One Citizen Daily reports the SSRA review of its E-Customs reform, which aims to digitise import-export procedures, noting strides in automating customs clearance alongside limited infrastructure and staff capacity gaps.

Sudans Post reports South Sudan's trade minister and revenue authority commissioner met on 5 January 2026 to coordinate a four-year, USD 10.8 million EU-funded one-stop border post at Nimule, combining customs automation and electronic clearance, with the design approved.
